meta.description: Use when working with LaminDB, the open-source lineage-native lakehouse for biological datasets and models. Covers setup, artifact registration, query/search, lineage tracking, validation, ontology-backed annotation with Bionty, collections, branches, storage, and workflow integrations.

scientific_integrity.detail: No data fabrication; manages real biological datasets with proper versioning, lineage tracking, and ontology-backed validation

practice_boundaries.detail: Appropriate scope for biological data lakehouse management with FAIR principles; clear integration boundaries with workflow managers and MLOps

methodological_ground.detail: Based on established FAIR data principles, biological ontologies (Bionty), and computational reproducibility practices

code_usability.detail: Complete working examples for all 6 capability areas with proper error handling and security patterns

functional_suitability.note: Comprehensive coverage of 6 interconnected capability areas (core concepts, data management, annotation/validation, ontologies, integrations, setup); excellent 6-reference progressive disclosure

reliability.note: Good version specification (lamindb==2.5.1, bionty==2.4.0) with Python compatibility (3.10-3.14); pinning guidance present; minor: optional module pinning could be more explicit

performance_context.note: Well-organized 409-line SKILL.md with excellent progressive disclosure through 6 detailed reference files; clear workflow structure with 4 use cases

agent_usability.note: Perfect trigger description with specific biological data and workflow patterns; comprehensive 'When to Use' section with 9 explicit use cases

human_usability.note: Excellent setup with installation options, extras documentation, getting started checklist, and 10 key principles for best practices

security.note: Good credential management with named environment variables and IAM role preference; validation/sanitization emphasized; minor: cloud storage permission patterns could be more explicit

maintainability.note: Good structure with version 1.1, license (Apache-2.0), compatibility; clear version pinning for core packages; minor: no explicit changelog reference

agent_specific.note: Strong composability with clear input/output contracts; excellent progressive disclosure with 6 references; 4 complete use-case workflows; minor: error handling patterns could be more explicit

key_strengths: Comprehensive coverage of 6 interconnected capability areas with excellent 6-reference progressive disclosure (core-concepts, data-management, annotation-validation, ontologies, integrations, setup-deployment)
Perfect agent discoverability with 9 explicit use cases covering scRNA-seq, lakehouse queries, ML pipelines, and workflow integrations
Strong FAIR data principles with automatic versioning, lineage tracking, ontology-backed validation (Bionty), and schema enforcement
Excellent getting started checklist and 10 key principles for effective LaminDB usage (track everything, validate early, use ontologies, organize with keys)
Four complete use-case workflows demonstrating scRNA-seq analysis, queryable lakehouse, ML with W&B, and Nextflow pipeline integration

recommendations.title: Add error handling for dual-system integration failures
recommendations.problem: W&B+LaminDB integration shown but no guidance on handling when one system fails
recommendations.root_cause: Agent-specific composability focuses on successful integration patterns
recommendations.fix: Add to integrations.md: error handling pattern for when W&B/MLflow fails but LaminDB succeeds (or vice versa), with guidance on partial recovery and cleanup

recommendations.title: Add explicit cloud storage permission patterns
recommendations.problem: S3/GCS mentioned but no explicit IAM policy or permission examples
recommendations.root_cause: Security section focuses on credential management rather than access patterns
recommendations.fix: Add to setup-deployment.md: example IAM policies/roles for S3 and GCS with minimal required permissions for read, write, and list operations

recommendations.title: Make optional module pinning more explicit
recommendations.problem: Core packages pinned but optional wetlab/clinical modules mentioned without version guidance
recommendations.root_cause: Reliability section focuses on core lamindb/bionty rather than ecosystem
recommendations.fix: Add to setup section: explicit guidance to pin reviewed releases for optional modules rather than floating latest, with example: uv pip install 'lnschema-wetlab==X.Y.Z'
